purpose: Define containment, relation, ownership, authority and dependency as distinct canonical structural dimensions that must be represented explicitly and must never be inferred from one another, from Topic membership, or from filesystem placement.

semantics.identity_rule: This member gives an exact owner-scoped identity to the literal Flow token without adding semantics beyond the owning Flow reference field and the preserved source literal.
semantics.interpretation_rule: Consumers may use this identity as an opaque declared Flow symbol. No meaning may be inferred from spelling, whitespace, filename, path or similarity to another symbol.
semantics.authority_rule: A Flow symbol is descriptive/causal model data only and never grants runtime authority, capability, ownership or execution permission.
semantics.scope_rule: Identity is scoped semantically to the defining contract; identical source literals in another contract or another Flow-ref role are not automatically the same semantic identity.

semantics.purpose: Group the canonical dimensions used to reconstruct semantic structure without inference.

metadata.ordering_note: Structural dimensions may be materialized independently. Their serialization order carries no semantics.

dimensions.relation: Declares a typed semantic relation only.
dimensions.ownership: Declares which semantic owner owns the target meaning/surface.
dimensions.authority: Declares runtime or policy authority only.
dimensions.dependency: Declares a required or optional dependency only.

non_implication_rules: containment does not imply execution order
authority does not imply structural admissibility
dependency does not imply execution order
Topic membership does not imply any structural dimension
Topic inheritance does not imply any structural dimension
Topic composition does not imply any structural dimension
filesystem hierarchy does not imply any structural dimension
semantics.causality_boundary: Execution causality belongs in explicit behavior.flows, never in structural edges alone.
semantics.projection_boundary: A projector may combine structural dimensions visually, but projected proximity, nesting or edge styling does not change their canonical meanings.

invariants.rule: Containment, relation, ownership, authority and dependency remain distinct canonical dimensions.
Structural edges alone never define execution causality.

hard_gates.condition: Ownership is inferred solely from containment.
Authority is inferred solely from ownership.
Execution order is inferred solely from dependency.
Topic membership, inheritance or composition is interpreted as containment, relation, ownership, authority or dependency.
Canonical structural meaning is inferred solely from filesystem placement.
Renderer position, nesting or visual edge style is interpreted as canonical structural meaning without explicit structured data.

references.purpose: Separates Topic grouping from structural semantics.
All structural endpoints must resolve through canonical identity resolution.

prose.summary: Separates containment, relations, ownership, authority and dependencies so a generic reader can reconstruct each dimension without cross-inference.
notes: Unlocked until the assembled 1.4 review tree validates all structural endpoints and cross-dimension rules.
Pass 8 formalized previously free Flow actor/data/target/condition/payload/result/error tokens as exact owner-scoped member identities while preserving every source literal.
